The '''Destreg system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Destreg II]].

==History==
The [[Assassination attempt on K'Armyn Viraxo|ambush]] of the ''[[Highroller]]'' took place in this [[Star system/Legends|system]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
